settlements.caseTitle: Amy Crull v. University of St. Thomas

settlements.title: Aidvantage $3 Million TCPA Class Action Settlement
settlements.description: Individuals who received a prerecorded call from Aidvantage and were not a customer may be eligible to claim $500 to $1,000 from a class action settlement.
settlements.caseTitle: Knox v. Maximus Education LLC d/b/a Aidvantage

settlements.title: USAA $647,000 Michigan Total Loss Class Action Settlement
settlements.description: People who insured a leased vehicle under a USAA Michigan policy and did not receive full sales tax or fees after a total loss may qualify for a settlement.
settlements.caseTitle: Marchek v. United Services Automobile Association
